name: Group.fg_of_descent
statement: Type*} [Group G] {f : G →* G} (hf : ∀ U : Subgroup G, U.map f ≤ U) {s : Set G} {h : G → ℝ} {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (H₀ : a < b) (hs : s.Finite) (H₁ : s * f.range = .univ) (H₂ : ∀ g ∈ s, ∀ x, h x ≤ a * h (g * x) + c) (H₃ : ∀ x, b * h x - c ≤ h (f x)) [Northcott h] : FG G
